source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 1 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、艺术(西方绘画/中国画/博物馆/艺术流派/著名画家)主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词(Christianity/Cubism/Impressionism 等)。

words.example_en: Chinese ink wash animation turns paintings into moving art.
words.example_cn: 中国水墨动画把绘画变成了会动的艺术。

words.example_en: Monet often painted the arch of the bridge in his garden.
words.example_cn: 莫奈常画他花园里那座桥的拱形。

words.example_en: The exhibition shows the artistic genius of ancient China.
words.example_cn: 这次展览展示了古代中国的艺术天才。

words.meaning_cn: 陶瓷制品;制陶艺术;陶瓷的
words.example_en: Beautiful ceramic vases were on display in the museum.
words.example_cn: 博物馆里展出着精美的陶瓷花瓶。

words.example_en: Tang Yin failed to gain entry into the civil service and turned to painting.
words.example_cn: 唐寅未能进入文官系统,转而从事绘画。

words.example_en: A good artist builds trust with every client.
words.example_cn: 优秀的艺术家会与每位客户建立信任。

words.meaning_cn: 当代的;现代的;同时期的;同代人
words.example_en: Contemporary art by young painters is also worthy of attention.
words.example_cn: 年轻画家创作的当代艺术也值得关注。

words.example_en: Monet's aim was to convey the light and movement in the scene.
words.example_cn: 莫奈的目标是表现场景中的光与动感。

words.example_en: A humble person finds it hard to criticise other people's work.
words.example_cn: 谦逊的人很难去指责别人的作品。

words.example_en: Honest art criticism can help an artist improve.
words.example_cn: 诚恳的艺术评论能帮助艺术家进步。

words.example_en: The speaker explained the decline in ink wash animation.
words.example_cn: 演讲者解释了水墨动画的衰落。

words.example_en: Unlike painting, sculpture operates in three dimensions.
words.example_cn: 与绘画不同,雕塑存在于三维空间中。

words.example_en: A painting on paper is a two-dimensional image.
words.example_cn: 纸上的画是一种二维的图像。

words.example_en: Impressionism emerged in France in the late 19th century.
words.example_cn: 印象主义于19世纪晚期在法国兴起。

words.example_en: He tried to gain entry into the civil service but failed.
words.example_cn: 他试图进入文官系统但失败了。

words.example_en: The museum's new exhibition runs until November.
words.example_cn: 博物馆的新展览将持续到十一月。

words.example_en: Buddhist art did not begin to show expansion until the seventh century.
words.example_cn: 佛教艺术直到七世纪才开始扩展。

words.example_en: The Richfield Museum of Fine Art is proud of its new show.
words.example_cn: 里奇菲尔德美术博物馆为其新展览感到自豪。

words.example_en: Which period of Western art are you most fond of?
words.example_cn: 你最喜爱西方艺术的哪个时期?

words.example_en: An animation film is drawn frame by frame.
words.example_cn: 动画片是一帧一帧地画出来的。

words.example_en: No one can guarantee that an artist will become famous.
words.example_cn: 没有人能保证一位艺术家会成名。

words.example_en: Renoir tried to show the inner warmth and humanity of his subjects.
words.example_cn: 雷诺阿努力表现画中人物内在的温暖与人性。

words.example_en: For a humble person, it is hard to praise themselves.
words.example_cn: 对谦逊的人来说,自我夸赞是很难的。

words.example_en: Monet, in particular, loved painting the water lilies in his pond.
words.example_cn: 莫奈尤其喜爱画他池塘里的睡莲。

words.meaning_cn: 有影响力的;有支配力的
words.example_en: Monet was one of the most influential Impressionist painters.
words.example_cn: 莫奈是最有影响力的印象派画家之一。

words.example_en: Chinese ink wash painting uses water and black ink.
words.example_cn: 中国水墨画使用水和黑墨。

words.meaning_cn: 投资;投资额;(时间精力的)投入
words.example_en: An art collector should have realistic expectations of any investment.
words.example_cn: 艺术收藏家对任何投资都应有现实的预期。

words.example_en: The leaders' aim was to build a memorial to the heroes.
words.example_cn: 领导人的目标是为英雄们建造一座纪念碑。

words.example_en: Many old European paintings show scenes from mythology.
words.example_cn: 许多古老的欧洲绘画描绘神话场景。

words.example_en: The mother's wish was to raise her son to have a noble mind.
words.example_cn: 母亲的愿望是把儿子培养成有崇高心灵的人。

words.example_en: Renoir wanted to show more than just the outer image of people.
words.example_cn: 雷诺阿想表现的不只是人物的外表形象。

words.example_en: The two leaders' aim was to achieve permanent peace.
words.example_cn: 两位领导人的目标是实现持久和平。

words.example_en: After the invention of photography, painters looked at art in a new way.
words.example_cn: 摄影术发明之后,画家们以新的方式看待艺术。

words.example_en: Monet painted the water lilies floating on the pond.
words.example_cn: 莫奈画了漂浮在池塘上的睡莲。

words.example_en: Impressionists did not aim to make a precise record of a scene.
words.example_cn: 印象派画家并不追求精确记录某个场景。

words.example_en: Realist painters tried to paint things precisely as they looked.
words.example_cn: 写实派画家力求把事物画得与实物完全一致。

words.meaning_cn: 原始的;远古的;发展水平低的
words.example_en: Some primitive art was carved on stone thousands of years ago.
words.example_cn: 一些原始艺术是数千年前刻在石头上的。

words.example_en: The first rule for any collector is to purchase only what you love.
words.example_cn: 任何收藏家的首要原则是只买你真正喜爱的。

words.example_en: Tang Yin gained a high rank among Chinese artists.
words.example_cn: 唐寅在中国艺术家中获得了崇高的地位。

words.example_en: Earlier Realists painted in a very realistic style.
words.example_cn: 早期的写实派画家以非常逼真的风格作画。

words.example_en: Realism in art tries to show life as it truly is.
words.example_cn: 艺术中的现实主义力求表现生活的真实样貌。

words.example_en: In time, Tang Yin gained recognition as a great artist.
words.example_cn: 假以时日,唐寅获得了伟大艺术家的赞誉。

words.meaning_cn: 典型的;有代表性的;代表
words.example_en: These three films are representative of ink wash animation.
words.example_cn: 这三部影片是水墨动画的代表作。

words.example_en: A great painter slowly builds a reputation over many years.
words.example_cn: 伟大的画家是在许多年里慢慢建立起名声的。

words.example_en: Tang Dynasty sculpture was highly influenced by Buddhist art.
words.example_cn: 唐代雕塑深受佛教艺术的影响。

words.example_en: The sculptor spent years carving a single stone figure.
words.example_cn: 这位雕塑家花了数年雕刻一座石像。

words.example_en: Monet painted the subjective impression a scene gave him.
words.example_cn: 莫奈画的是场景给他的主观印象。

words.example_en: After Impressionism, subsequent artists asked what to do next.
words.example_cn: 印象主义之后,后来的艺术家们思考接下来该做什么。

words.example_en: The film's music sounds like a gentle symphony.
words.example_cn: 这部影片的音乐听起来像一首柔和的交响曲。

words.example_en: A blue ceramic vase stood at the centre of the exhibition.
words.example_cn: 一只蓝色的陶瓷花瓶摆在展览的中央。

words.example_en: Monet was impressed by the visual effects of the steam engine.
words.example_cn: 莫奈对蒸汽机车的视觉效果印象深刻。

words.example_en: Contemporary art is also worthy of your attention.
words.example_cn: 当代艺术也值得你的关注。
